steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio? Mio!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Shakes tail irritably)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What's the matter, Mio? You've been drowsy since yesterday...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Strange. Are you sick? Let me see...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: *Ancient Sargonian*!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Get your hands off my eyelids, impertinent servant!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: If you keep doing that, I'll...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Zzz...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio? Passed out again...

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Don't worry, Lazvar, we're not as frail as you think.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: The auction is about to start. I've got to go... Look after Mio for me, won't you?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Leave it to me.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: We know that you have many responsibilities, aside from seeking the Guardian's gem.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Spend your limited time and energy on more important matters.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Lost? You lost the Falling Star?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: W-We're so sorry! We spent all night searching every corner of the warehouse, but couldn't find it anywhere...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: That's supposed to be the highlight of the auction...

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: What do we do, Mr. Lazvar? The auction's about to start...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Doyard, get in touch with everyone who came to the warehouse in the past several days, especially anyone who inquired or came into contact with the Falling Star.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Abbas, draft a contingency plan on the delay of the auction. Estimate the cost for rescheduling and the total liquidated damages.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I'll look for new consignors, see if we can get something on par with or better than the Falling Star.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Let's focus on our jobs for now. Don't worry, we'll find a way.

steps.name: Trading Post Staff
steps.text: ...Understood, Mr. Lazvar. We'll do as you say.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: I thought we were going to get fired for sure. I guess the high turnover at the trading post wasn't because of the staff making mistakes?

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: And thinking of it, why does trouble always happen at the worst possible time?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Let's hope we can find it... I really wish this was all just a bad dream.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...So, we would very much appreciate it if you have any gems you're interested in auctioning.

steps.name: Apologetic Shopkeeper
steps.text: I'm really sorry, but a customer already bought out our best gems a few days ago.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: No need to apologize. I didn't give you any notice I'd be coming, after all.

steps.name: Tired Shopkeeper
steps.text: I'm afraid you've seen all my goods, Mr. Lazvar. I don't think we have any gems that can satisfy your requirements.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: It's fine, I'll just keep looking around. Thank you for your time.

steps.name: Earnest Shopkeeper
steps.text: How about this crystal brooch, Mr. Lazvar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I'm afraid its flaws are too apparent to be the highlight of an auction.

steps.name: Earnest Shopkeeper
steps.text: All you need to do is give it a good starting price, just a tad bit higher than the other items...

steps.name: Earnest Shopkeeper
steps.text: If it's the overseer's appraisal, then it's all legit! We can offer many, er, perks, if you would just nod...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: No, thank you.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I'll take my leave.

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: Mr. Lazvar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Abbas? What is it?

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: Bad news, sir.

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: The Lord Ameer just sent word that a wealthy foreign merchant by the name of Sotheby is coming to Menat in a few days to discuss business, and instructs us to welcome him with the utmost hospitality.

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: Mr. Sotheby came for the gem with healing effects that's being auctioned. Considering his schedule, we can't delay the event for too long.

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: The Lord Ameer's herald said that Mr. Sotheby saw the auction leaflet and is very interested in the healing effects of the Falling Star. He wants to have a look at the gem at the preview.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: How long is Mr. Sotheby staying?

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: He's going to Siesta for the music festival next, so up to one week, at most.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Move the auction to the day before he leaves.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Has Doyard looked into those who had contact with the Falling Star?

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: Yes, sir. They all came up clean. It's strange...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Cautious Voice
steps.text: Mr. Lazvar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: It's nothing. I got it.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I'll be hanging up if there's nothing else.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What is it this time?

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Hello! Are you perhaps in a spot of trouble?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...Who is this?

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Ah, pardon me. This is Four-Fin Domestic Services Limited.

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: We help take care of every problem in your life: appliance repair, plumbing, pest extermination, and even looking for lost items!

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Feel free to call us at this number if you need anything!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Really? But you sound really tired. Are you sure—

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: It's okay! Just tell us what's troubling you, and we'll do our best to help with whatever it is!

steps.name: Polite Voice
steps.text: Maybe you could save our number?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: That's enough...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Wait. Did he say 'looking for lost items'?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: No, what am I thinking... was I really considering asking a dodgy 'domestic service' company to help find an auction item?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Can't keep thinking about the Falling Star... I've got to find another way.
A dark alley. This is the shortest route from the Great Bazaar back to the trading post.
The young overseer walks alone. There are voices coming through the gaps in the brick walls.

steps.name: Voices in Discussion
steps.text: Looks like there's trouble at the trading post again...

steps.name: Voices in Discussion
steps.text: Ha! Nothing to worry about. Not the first time and won't be the last.

steps.name: Voices in Discussion
steps.text: Mr. Lazvar is always meticulous about the auctions... but who cares if one doesn't go well once in a while?

steps.name: Voices in Discussion
steps.text: You think it won't go well? The show will go on, as long as those magical healing gems keep coming to Menat-Ha'mait.

steps.name: Voices in Discussion
steps.text: Just you wait. With Mr. Lazvar around, this will be the best auction ever!
The overseer recalls hiding in this dark alley as a child, making his mother and grandfather fret as they looked for them.
He had innocently believed that doing so would make them open that heavy brick-colored door, and walk away from the burden of responsibility and guilt.
Now, though, he feels the weight his ancestors felt on their own hearts as they walked through here like never before.
Suddenly, he sees a familiar figure.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Dio? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: It's getting very late.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Oh, I didn't realize... I should have been spending more time with you guys.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What about Mio? Getting any better?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: You should worry more about yourself.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Come home, Lazvar, and have a good sleep.
The next day...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...My head hurts.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: I told you to get sleep, not to stay up all night.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I had to look through the bidders' files. We don't have much time, and I need to figure out what they need, and what they like.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Say, are you sure you don't want me to get a vet to take a look at Mio? I'm still concerned...

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: I told you, humans can't see us unless we want to be seen. Give it up.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Hey, what are...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Stop licking my wrist, Dio. Oh, it tickles... I know, I know, you want me to pat you on the head, right?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: (Looks up)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Sorry I've been neglecting you guys...

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: I'm fine, and Mio will be too. You shouldn't neglect your own feelings.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: That forced smile on your face is exactly like the one in this photo.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Photo? You mean Mr. Sotheby's?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Yeah. Everyone else in the photo is grinning from ear to ear, but he's the only one barely even raising the corners of his mouth.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Hey, it's the same for all his other photos in the file... even in the one with his favorite band.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: What does it mean?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: It means you may just have done me a huge favor, Dio.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mr. Farshid.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I was wondering who could get my secretary to arrange an urgent meeting first thing in the morning. No wonder.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: What brings you here personally, Mr. Lazvar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I want to make a deal.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I know there is a perfectly cut yellowish-green gem in your collection, immaculate in both appearance and efficacy.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: ...The Sun of Sand.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I see. You want to craft it into an auction highlight?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I'm sure you understand, Mr. Farshid, that the overseer seldom leaves the Great Bazaar to deal with citizens not in the gem trade.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Is that so? I thought your mother and grandfather never came to me because they didn't like me.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I was a rule-breaker. I abused their names to raise prices on my gems, they said.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: You did. It was against the principles of the gem trading post.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Anyway, my gem vendor permit was revoked... Fortunately, my advertising company is still doing well.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I just feel sorry for my gems sitting at home collecting dust, with no one to admire it but myself.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I take it your answer is no.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Very well then. I apologize for taking up your time.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Wait! One second.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: As an honest citizen of Menat, I'm of course happy to support the new overseer.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: But the consigning fee is not insignificant, you understand...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: We can waive it.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: ...And my vendor permit?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: You can submit an application for reinstatement. I will approve it after the probation period.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: There's a probation period?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...Do not push your luck.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Ha. Well, everyone in this town knows that your word is golden, Mr. Lazvar, and I suppose showing some good faith is the least I could do.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I'll have the Sun of Sand sent to the trading post.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: What did Farshid say? I heard he had a grudge against the trading post...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: He said yes.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: I was sure it didn't go well, what with that look on your face...

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: By the way, here are Mr. Sotheby's recent spending records you had me look up.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Is that the section on medical and cosmetic expenses?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Teeth whitening?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: It seems we were looking in the right direction.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Mr. Lazvar!

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Just one, tiny little request, if I may?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...Go ahead.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Well, to be honest, my company's ads haven't been doing that well lately, but I have an amazing idea this time...

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: I'm positive it will be a great way to both advertise the Sun of Sand, and change the overly solemn image of the trading post.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: There's no need to change the trading post's image.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: ...Well, I won't lie, I also want to increase exposure for my company.

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Give and take. That's what business is all about, isn't it?

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Great idea, don't you think?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: (Whisper) Mr. Lazvar, this man is just trying to take advantage of us.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: So, what do you want me to do?

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: Since we're putting the Sun of Sand on auction, I was thinking about making some posters for it...

steps.name: Gem Collector
steps.text: ...And I could think of no better model than you!

a.text: The Sun of Sand, the eternal oasis, the sun that never sets.
Royal artificers have crafted the ultimate masterpiece of teeth whitening.
You, too, can become the owner of this wonderful gem, and a mouth full of white teeth!
Brought to you by Lazvar, overseer of Menat-Ha'mait Gem Trading Post—
Whatever chances you may have missed in life, don't miss this one!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: When I give you the cue, lift your chin, show your teeth, and smile!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: A little further to the right! Next to the statue. That's right!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Smile!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Er, sir, you need to show your teeth, so that we can demonstrate the effects of the Sun of Sand.

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Youth and sunshine! Grin from ear to ear!

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Oh dear, you're frowning now... Mm? There's actually a good one.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: What's going on, Doyard?

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: How did Farshid get Mr. Lazvar to agree to be the model for the teeth whitening ad?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: It's a long story... I would refrain from snide comments if I were you. I doubt Mr. Lazvar is in the best mood right now.

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: Good. Let's take a break.

steps.name: Photographer
steps.text: You're being too tense. Perhaps a more familiar environment will help you loosen up a bit?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Nice posters. How long will they stay up at the trading post and Great Bazaar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...No later than the auction.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: You should keep one. I like this one, with the trading post in the background. The smile looks so natural.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Don't even start. I don't know if my face muscles will ever be the same again...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio's still sleeping...

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Don't worry, it's only been a few days. Mio and I have slept for centuries before.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: And you really should get some sleep once this auction is over.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: The trading post and Great Bazaar are never idle, you know, even when there's nothing in particular going on.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Are you tired of it?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: But I've been having... strange dreams.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: In the dream, I wasn't the overseer sitting behind the counter, but a clockwork fowlbeast sent out to fly through the streets, perching to rest when the wind grows strong.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Rolls over leisurely)

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Wags tail relaxedly)

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Like Mio?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Haha. Maybe.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Well, Mio is going to miss this auction if they don't wake up. I wanted you guys to help keep an eye on the news that the merchants bring from outside...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: There are still two missing guardian gems.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: As you search for them, Lazvar, I hope you don't forget that your own time is limited too.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: My time is limited, but the life of an overseer only ends when the gems are returned. I'm just doing my duty.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: And I want to reunite you guys with the trove guardian sooner rather than later.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: He's important to you and Mio, isn't he?

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: ...Of course.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: Lazvar, when was the last time you took a photo for yourself?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Last time... I think it was when my mother was still around.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: We should have the photographer of the poster take a photo for us.

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: I don't know if he'll be able to capture Mio and I, but at least you will know we were by your side.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Dio...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Sure. I'd love to.
Day of the auction

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Tea or coffee, Mr. Sotheby?

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: No need. Just lemon water, and please make sure there's no extra coloring in it.

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Here you go. Please feel free to let me know if you need anything else.

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: I will, thank you.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Mr. Lazvar was right. Mr. Sotheby has yellow teeth.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Did he ask about the Falling Star?

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Not one word. He was holding the leaflet for the Sun of Sand, you know, the one with Mr. Lazvar's photo on it.

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: He sure has his eye on it...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Now, the highlight of the auction.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: From Mr. Farshid, I present to you the Sun of Sand, the brightest sun of Sargon.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Bidding will start at nine million dinar.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Eleven million. Thirteen million. Fifteen million. Seventeen million. Seventeen million.

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Nineteen million from Mr. Sotheby. Nineteen million.

steps.name: Menat Merchant
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Twenty-one million from Mrs. Shalmar, Titan Jewelry. Twenty-one million.

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Menat Merchant
steps.text: (Raises bid card)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Twenty-three million. Twenty-five million. Twenty-seven million. Twenty-nine million from Mr. Hamut, Djinni Trade Association.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mr. Sotheby? What are you—

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: I'm leaving my card here. Where's that staff member? Nail my card to the wall, or use Originium Arts, I don't care.

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: I'm keeping it up and I'm not putting it down, never, no matter how much you people bid!

steps.name: Foreign Merchant
steps.text: Let's see who's trying to take the Sun of Sand from me?!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...Thirty-one million, from Mr. Sotheby. Thirty-one million going once. Thirty-one million going twice.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Sold!

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: Wow, that didn't feel real... the auction comes to a close, and the crisis is over?

steps.name: Male Trading Post Staff
steps.text: I can't believe Mr. Sotheby was so happy about it...

steps.name: Female Trading Post Staff
steps.text: I told you, Mr. Lazvar would find a way out.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: I can't guarantee a happy ending every time. Besides, we haven't found the Falling Star...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: What? You said... Mio...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio's not breathing?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Mio, Mio!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Oh no... the breaths are so weak...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Hang in there, I'll get you a doctor!

steps.name: Dio
steps.text: I told you, there's no point.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Give me a hand, Dio, I need to get Mio up...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Hey, did something just fall out from the pillow?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Stretches)

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: A gem... the missing Falling Star! How did it end up under Mio's pillow?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Shut up, you're making my head hurt...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: What did you just say, Lazvar?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Finally! You're awake!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Finally?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: So it was the Falling Star that made you fall asleep...

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: 'A gem that grants restful sleep.'

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: It's in the item description. I should have realized...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Shouldn't you be keeping a close eye on dangerous gems like this?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It's a pretty powerful one, to be able to knock a Sovereign of Beasts out.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: ...If you want to play with a gem, you should tell me first.

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: You have no idea how much trouble I had to go through because it went missing...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: (Glares)

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: What? Are you blaming me?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: How was I to know it would knock me out so quickly, when all I did was hold it for a while?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: And how was I supposed to tell you when I'm asleep?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Plus, this is mainly your fault!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: My fault?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: If you had picked me up earlier and took me away from the gem, I wouldn't be sleeping for so long, and you would have found it!

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Well... are you feeling okay now?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Not especially, other than being rudely woken up.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: ...What are you grinning about, human?

steps.name: Lazvar
steps.text: Ha... nothing, nothing. Just happy that you're well.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You're hugging me too tight! I haven't forgiven you yet, Lazvar!
